prs.title: feat(tally): pad the count column with --width
prs.head: feat/width
prs.author: dev
prs.body:
## Why
Counts past 99999 push the words out of line.

## What changed
- `--width N` sets the count column width; the default of 5 keeps today's output.
- `format_row` is now `format_line`, which takes the width.

## Scope
- Output padding only.

## Blast Radius
Callers of `format_row` move to `format_line`.

## Verification
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`
